title: Michigan Small Claims Court (2026): Limit, Fees & How to File
rank_math_title: Michigan Small Claims Court (2026): $7,000 Limit & Fees
rank_math_description: Michigan small claims in 2026: $7,000 limit, $30-$70 fees, no lawyers or collection agencies, five claims a week, and the 7-day magistrate appeal rule.
pdf_outline: Checklist: demand letter -> right district court -> Affidavit and Claim (+1 copy per defendant) -> fee ($30/$50/$70) + postage -> clerk mails -> decide: stay, ask for judge, or remove -> hearing -> 7-day appeal (magistrate only) -> collection ($15 writs)
Box: rights you waive by staying in small claims (MCL 600.8412)
